source.title: Robonine: Practical comparison of smart serial servo motors for robotics

independenceNote: Robonine blog test; Robonine sells Feetech-based arm kits. Firmware dead zone may inflate encoder-count backlash.
methodNote: Peak torque from a 3.3 kgf reading on a 10 cm lever at full load. Backlash is the post's mean of 8.75 encoder counts, converted by us at about 0.088° per count; the post does not say how many readings the mean uses. The post states no uncertainties: ±5.3 arcmin is one encoder count (reading resolution, not the spread of the readings) and ±0.2 N·m is our estimate for the scale reading.

rig.torqueSensor: force gauge on a 10 cm lever

claims.source: Feetech datasheet 0.5° or less, as quoted by Robonine; Feetech primary not verified

note: Largest backlash of the five servos compared, above the 0.5° the datasheet gives.
